items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Torme's 'California Suite' and Interviewee responds 'Yes.'

ctx.x: Yes. We are young people. We are 70 years young.

Yes. What did Eubie Blake say? He says, “If I’d have known I was going to live this long I’d have taken better care of myself.” But anyway, I always wanted to come to the States. And you know how it is, you know, when you hear Torme’s “California Suite,” you say oh, boy, California, you know. Walk along Hollywood Boulevard, and huh, so this is Hollywood Boulevard. But the way it’s built up you know. I came over first on the boat on The America. And I literally landed in New York, put my foot on the ground and I…
